theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_mass_measure_rectifiable
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W + T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ μ : Measure (Eucl P), IsMassMeasure T μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < dimensionalUpperDensity μ.toOuterMeasure ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) univ x) → ∃ (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ), M ⊆ U ∧ MeasurableSet M ∧ CountablyRectifiable (m + 1) M ∧ Measurable θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∧ μ = ((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
